title: Ahijah Predicts Jeroboam's Kingdom
description: Jeroboam, a capable and hardworking man in Solomon's service, meets the prophet Ahijah from Shiloh on the road outside Jerusalem. Ahijah tears his new cloak into twelve pieces and gives ten of them to Jeroboam as a sign that the Lord will tear the kingdom away from Solomon's son and give Jeroboam rule over ten tribes, while one tribe shall remain for the sake of David and Jerusalem.
